en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 36. And from the previous chain from Muhammad b. al-Hussain from Ahmad b. al-Nadhr Nakha’i from Shihab b. Abd Rabbuhu or from a man from Shihab from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:
“Perform it twenty times and you would be like one who does the Ziyarat of Imam Husain Ibne Ali (a.s.) once.”
